prOriginal.nota: PR 'ref(span-buffer): Introduce multiprocessed flusher' (branch spans-buffer-multiprocessing); its last commit is the benchmark head 3162ad68. Squash commit 9bf83b05 on master has no diff from the head under src/sentry/spans, src/sentry/consumers and tests/sentry/spans.

span-buffer-multiprocess-enhancement-wit.reason: _ensure_processes_alive kept `if isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process): process.kill()` until PR #115050 'fix(span-buffer): Fix another process leak' (merged 2026-05-07) changed it to isinstance(process, multiprocessing.process.BaseProcess), which SpawnProcess satisfies. Master today has the BaseProcess check before kill().

join() kept the `if remaining_time <= 0: break` before terminate() until PR #114955 'fix(span-buffer): Fix flusher processes leaking on timeout' (merged 2026-05-06) removed the break and kills every process, with a test that reproduces the early break on timeout. Master today loops over all processes and calls kill() on each.

SpanFlusher.__init__ on master still sets self.max_processes = max_processes or len(buffer.assigned_shards), and --flusher-processes is still a plain click int option (default 1) forwarded by factory.py without validation, so 0 still becomes one process per shard.

submit() on master still loops `for buffer in self.buffers.values(): memory_infos.extend(buffer.get_memory_info())`, and SpansBuffer.get_memory_info still returns iter_cluster_memory_usage(self.client) where every buffer's client is the same get_redis_client() cluster. The cluster-wide INFO is still repeated once per flusher process buffer.
